answer_1.quote: ... our goal is to extract such sentences, i.e., sentences that are both helpful for a purchase decision and faithful. We develop an end‑to‑end model that given a set of product reviews, extracts a single positive RHS and a single negative RHS.
datasets: Helpful Sentence Dataset (20,000 train, 2,000 test) derived from Amazon.com product reviews
Amazon review corpus (123 products across 6 categories)
answer_1.outputs: Single extracted sentence per sentiment (positive and negative) that is helpful and well‑supported

answer_2.quote: ... we evaluate our model by averaging NDCG@K over all products for K ∈ {1,10}. We also report ROUGE scores and use MSE, Pearson correlation and NDCG@1 for the helpfulness component.

answer_4.quote: We asked crowd workers to rate each of the selected sentences in a 5‑level scale according to how helpful the selected sentence was for a purchase decision (our objective) and according to how well the selected sentence summarized the review (the traditional objective). Each sentence was annotated by 5 workers.
answer_4.guideline: Crowd workers rated sentences on a 5‑point Likert scale for helpfulness and summarization quality.
criteria: summary quality (how well it summarizes the review)
